w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: The defenders met them at the treeline — nothing reached your bedroll.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (17/10/9), with 8 wave-4 fought, 12 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 6 · Forage 6 · Craft 8 · Talk 18 · Explore 30 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The middle road is open.
finalLabel: Write the contract. Make it sign.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE RELAY — "Write the contract. Make it sign."
◈ THE ARCHITECT — Declan Lonergan ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

◈ THE PANTHEON — Ethan Hunt and Declan Lonergan ascended together, and gods, it turns out, have politics. They argue about you the way the living argue about weather. Mostly, they agree: the village comes first. Mostly.
